name: Countdown Timer
description: Count down to any date and time with a live, second-by-second display of days, hours, minutes, and seconds remaining.

faq.question: Does the countdown keep running if I switch tabs or come back later?
faq.answer: Yes — it recalculates from your device's current clock and the target time every second, rather than counting down from a fixed starting number, so it's correct whenever you look at it, even after the tab was in the background.

faq.question: What timezone is the target time in?
faq.answer: Your device's local timezone — the date/time picker uses your system clock, and the countdown compares against that same local time throughout.
